provenance.rule: Keep every frozen source, source costs, matched deltas, record order and workload unchanged; only project the new champion group costs.

original_model.formula: For each run and operation: sum(candidate_group_ns_per_work * public_group_work) / sum(champion_group_ns_per_work * the_same_public_group_work); median over all retained exact-source full-gate runs. Whole uses summed ns before division.
assumptions: Champion private-suite group mean costs approximate the same named public-suite groups.
Cross-run hardware cost scale is assumed 1.0; no matched CPU calibration is available.
Both sources use the original gate ns-per-work units; length, shape and value distributions can differ.
original_model.scope: User-requested development gap estimate. Direct same-suite champion comparison and official admission remain UNKNOWN. No use of the overall champion speedup as a per-operation factor.
original_model.range_scope: Min/max across the projected public runs, not a confidence interval.
